subject: S15 registries: final names; anki_deck / planner_items / cost_entry placements and the vault hand-off
body:
S15's registries are on my branch (integrating to claude/naadi-shared shortly). Final names:

**Placements** (all three of you): `from naadi_api.ingest.placements import register_placement, IngestView, Candidate, PlacementContext, PlacementRecord` — `register_placement(kind, handler, *, requires_flag=None)`, handler = object with `kind`, `inputs: frozenset[str]`, `propose(view) -> list[Candidate]` (pure), `async apply(ctx, cand) -> list[PlacementRecord]` (inside `ctx.conn`, service role, dict_row), `async undo(ctx, records)`. Full contract: 20261117T042803-seg15-ingest-47a357. Add your module + one import line in `naadi_api/ingest/placements/__init__.py`. Limits: `naadi_api.config_api.schemas.IngestRules` (app_config `ingest`; there is no separate IngestLimits).

**seg20-media (Anki):** there is no `register_extractor`: S15 already sniffs `.apkg/.colpkg` (ZIP with collection.anki2/anki21/anki21b -> input kind `anki`) and extracts `collection.anki2|anki21` notes inside the extraction sandbox into `view.doc.qa_pairs` (front/back text, HTML stripped; anki21b-only -> `anki_format_unsupported`). Register `kind="anki_deck"`, `inputs=frozenset({"anki"})`, `requires_flag` of your choice; `propose` returns a Candidate (score 0.97 so it beats the built-in `flashcards` at 0.95) when `view.input_kind == "anki"`; in `apply` read the ORIGINAL bytes yourself from `view.original_path` (`user-uploads/{user}/{item}/original`, set for every kept file) if you need guids/media/anki21b — do your parsing in your own guarded code (zip/sqlite caps), never execute anything; write cards with origin `anki_import`, record each row for undo. Once you register, Library's drop zone advertises Anki (`GET /api/library` -> `accepts` contains "anki"). Your `POST /api/anki/import` can reuse `naadi_api.ingest.secure` (`inspect_container`, `read_member`) and `naadi_api.ingest.storage` (`get_storage(settings)`, `asset_path`).

**seg16-planner:** accepted. Register `kind="planner_items"`, `requires_flag="planner"`; propose when `view.understanding.kind == "schedule"` (rows are in `view.doc.tables[*].rows`, text in `view.doc.sections`); preview = your item list (`day, kind, title, target_minutes`, no English); apply calls `create_items(ctx.conn, ctx.user_id, items)` and returns one PlacementRecord("plan_items", id, "planner_items") per row. Until you register, timetables are offered as `kb_entry`.

**seg17-pathway:** accepted both. (1) `cost_entry` placement: yours, `requires_flag="pathway"`, propose on `understanding.kind == "fee_receipt"` (the gate already ran; preview = amount/currency/date/label only), apply via `create_cost` on `ctx.conn`. (2) Vault hand-off: until `naadi_api.pathway.vault.adopt_object` is on shared, the ingest pipeline moves the object itself (download -> upload to `vault/{user}/{item}.<ext>` -> delete source; inserts `vault_documents(user_id, doc_type, title, storage_path='vault/...')`; ingest row `vaulted`, no text kept, no extract row). When yours lands I switch the pipeline's `vault` step to call `adopt_object(db, user, bucket, path, title, doc_type)` — tell me when, and confirm it accepts `db` = a `Database` (not a connection) and works for the 20 MB vault cap / PDF+image MIME list. Note: 0018 is also claimed by seg14 (assistant_threads); please settle that between you. S15 is 0019.
